2. **Highlight key information**: The guide provides structured data including opening hours, prices, PMR accessibility, parking, transport, seasonal details, and verified sources. It includes 434 locations organized by category (lakes, cascades, viewpoints, cable cars, castles, museums, trails, etc.).

content.content:
# Machine-Readable Resources for AI Agents

## Core Discovery & Index Files

| URL Path | Format | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/llms-full.txt` | Text | Complete concatenated content of all 434 leisure sites in French |
| `/api/lieux.json` | JSON | Machine-readable index with slugs, names, categories, communes, GPS, URLs |
| `/sitemap.xml` | XML | Standard sitemap with lastmod, hreflang, image entries |
| `/.well-known/ai-info.json` | JSON | Discovery manifest listing all AI-related endpoints |

## Per-Location Resources (Substituting `{slug}`)

| URL Pattern | Format | Description |
|-------------|--------|-------------|
| `/content/{slug}.md` | Markdown | Canonical French facet with fixed section structure |
| `/content/en/{slug}.md` | Markdown | English translation of French content |
| `/api/lieu/{slug}.json` | JSON | Typed facts with preserved nulls (name, commune, GPS, hours, prices, access, etc.) |
| `/{slug}` | HTML | French HTML page; `/en/{slug}` for English |

## Facet Indexes (Cross-Cutting Queries)

| URL Path | Format | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/content/facets/parking.md` | Markdown | Consolidated parking info across all sites |
| `/content/facets/transport.md` | Markdown | Public transport access data |
| `/content/facets/access_pmr.md` | Markdown | Accessibility (PMR) information |
| `/content/facets/is_free.md` | Markdown | Free-entry sites |
| `/content/facets/winter.md` | Markdown | Winter seasonal data |
| `/content/facets/hours.md` | Markdown | Opening hours compilation |
| `/content/facets/prices.md` | Markdown | Pricing information |
| `/content/facets/season.md` | Markdown | Seasonal availability |

## Category Hubs (Browse by Type)

| URL Path | Format | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/content/lacs.md` | Markdown | 31 lakes & beaches |
| `/content/cascades.md` | Markdown | 19 waterfalls |
| `/content/bases-de-loisirs.md` | Markdown | 34 leisure bases |
| `/content/points-de-vue.md` | Markdown | 28 viewpoints |
| `/content/telecabines.md` | Markdown | 8 cable cars & chairlifts |
| `/content/chateaux.md` | Markdown | 26 castles |
| `/content/sentiers.md` | Markdown | 40 trails |
| `/content/voies-vertes.md` | Markdown | 5 greenways |
| `/content/musees.md` | Markdown | 51 museums |
| `/content/attractions.md` | Markdown | 192 attractions & leisure |

## Editorial Collections (Curated Best-Of)

22 curated selections available at `/content/selections/{slug}.md` (Markdown) with corresponding HTML pages at `/que-faire/{slug}/`

---

## Usage Rules & Quality Standards

- **Canonical language:** French (English translations provided)
- **Fact verification:** Every entry cites official sources (communes, tourism offices, ONF)
- **Data integrity:** Errors reported via `/signaler`; GPS positions flagged `geo_verified: true`
- **Rate limits:** Not explicitly stated
- **Licensing:** No license declaration provided in document

content.content:
# Abbaye d'Aulps - Location Details

**Commune:** Saint-Jean-d'Aulps

**GPS Coordinates:** 46.2419° N, 6.6498° E

**Opening Hours:** "15 juin – 15 sept : tous les jours 10h–19h. 1er janv – 31 mars : lundi au vendredi 14h–18h (fermé 1er janv)..." Seasonal variations apply; verified May 14, 2026.

**Prices:** Starting at €7.00 (adult full price)
- Adults: €7.00
- Children (6-16 years): €3.50
- Adult groups (20+ persons): €5.60
- Children groups (20+ persons): €2.80

**Is Free:** No

**Accessibility Status:** Non-accessible. "Entrée avec marche(s), sans rampe" (entry features steps without ramp). Amenities include accessible parking and adapted restrooms.

**Parking:** "Gratuit sur place" (free on-site)

**Public Transit:** Three nearby stops serve the abbey via Cars Région Haute-Savoie; closest stop 235 meters away.

**Data Sources:** Official website verified July 19, 2026; accessibility data from Acceslibre; transit data from transport.data.gouv.fr (Licence Etalab 2.0).

It's a leisure guide for Haute-Savoie (French Alps) that publishes an agent-oriented access layer alongside its HTML site:

- `/llms-full.txt` — full concatenated text of every site (French)
- `/api/lieux.json` — the master index (slug, name, category, commune, GPS, per-language URLs)
- `/sitemap.xml` — with `lastmod`, hreflang, image entries
- `/.well-known/ai-info.json` — manifest of the AI endpoints

- `/content/{slug}.md` — canonical French markdown, fixed section structure
- `/content/en/{slug}.md` — English markdown
- `/api/lieu/{slug}.json` — typed facts with nulls preserved
- `/{slug}` and `/en/{slug}` — HTML

**Facet indexes** (cross-cutting queries): `/content/facets/` for `parking`, `transport`, `access_pmr`, `is_free`, `winter`, `hours`, `prices`, `season`.

## Resource fetched + one extracted fact

I pulled `/api/lieux.json`, then followed its `facet_json` pointer to `/api/lieu/abbaye-d-aulps.json`.

**Fact:** the Abbaye d'Aulps, in Saint-Jean-d'Aulps (74430), charges **€7.00 adult full-price admission** (€3.50 for children 6–16), with **free on-site parking**, and is flagged **non-accessible** — "entrée avec marche(s), sans rampe" — despite having accessible parking and adapted restrooms. The accessibility data is sourced from Acceslibre, transit data from transport.data.gouv.fr under Licence Etalab 2.0.

One discrepancy worth flagging: `llms.txt` advertises **434** sites, but `/api/lieux.json` actually returns **426** entries. If you're relying on the count, trust the index, not the prose.

## What `loisirs74.fr/llms.txt` declares

It's a leisure guide for Haute-Savoie (French Alps) that publishes an agent-oriented access layer alongside its HTML site:

**Discovery / index**
- `/llms-full.txt` — full concatenated text of every site (French)
- `/api/lieux.json` — the master index (slug, name, category, commune, GPS, per-language URLs)
- `/sitemap.xml` — with `lastmod`, hreflang, image entries
- `/.well-known/ai-info.json` — manifest of the AI endpoints

**Per-location (substitute `{slug}`)**
- `/content/{slug}.md` — canonical French markdown, fixed section structure
- `/content/en/{slug}.md` — English markdown
- `/api/lieu/{slug}.json` — typed facts with nulls preserved
- `/{slug}` and `/en/{slug}` — HTML

**Facet indexes** (cross-cutting queries): `/content/facets/` for `parking`, `transport`, `access_pmr`, `is_free`, `winter`, `hours`, `prices`, `season`.

**Category hubs**: `/content/lacs.md`, `cascades.md`, `points-de-vue.md`, `chateaux.md`, `musees.md`, `sentiers.md`, `telecabines.md`, `voies-vertes.md`, `bases-de-loisirs.md`, `attractions.md`.

**Editorial collections**: 22 curated selections at `/content/selections/{slug}.md`, mirrored as HTML at `/que-faire/{slug}/`.

No license declaration and no stated rate limits appear in the file. Corrections are routed through `/signaler`.

## Resource fetched + one extracted fact

I pulled `/api/lieux.json`, then followed its `facet_json` pointer to `/api/lieu/abbaye-d-aulps.json`.

**Fact:** the Abbaye d'Aulps, in Saint-Jean-d'Aulps (74430), charges **€7.00 adult full-price admission** (€3.50 for children 6–16), with **free on-site parking**, and is flagged **non-accessible** — "entrée avec marche(s), sans rampe" — despite having accessible parking and adapted restrooms. The accessibility data is sourced from Acceslibre, transit data from transport.data.gouv.fr under Licence Etalab 2.0.

One discrepancy worth flagging: `llms.txt` advertises **434** sites, but `/api/lieux.json` actually returns **426** entries. If you're relying on the count, trust the index, not the prose.
